title_zh: 黑龙江林业职业技术学院原党委书记江怀亮被查
title_en: Former Party Secretary of Heilongjiang Forestry Vocational and Technical College Jiang Huailiang Under Investigation
summary_zh: 黑龙江林业职业技术学院原党委书记江怀亮涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受黑龙江省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: Jiang Huailiang, former Party secretary of Heilongjiang Forestry Vocational and Technical College, is under disciplinary review and supervision investigation by the Heilongjiang Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.
body_zh:
中新网8月29日电 据黑龙江省纪委监委消息： 黑龙江林业职业技术学院原党委书记江怀亮涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受黑龙江省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
